summary_for_children: Al-Balad means The City. It says Allah showed us two ways and the steep pass is freeing a slave and feeding the hungry and orphans.
environment_concept: The path forks into two ways (90:10): an easy path that wanders off, and a steep, narrow pass between rocks (90:11). At the top of the pass waits a table set for feeding on a day of hunger (90:14). No person is shown, and the fire of 90:20 is not pictured.
architecture_and_scenery: A forked path, a narrow rocky pass with steps, a table with bread at the top.

areas.name: Two Ways
areas.description: The path forks: one way easy, one way steep.

areas.name: The Difficult Pass
areas.description: A narrow pass between tall rocks, with rough steps.

areas.name: Feeding in Hunger
areas.description: A table at the top of the pass with bread and water.
